name: Clocktide Drift
introDiscord:
A school of Jellyfish drifts through suspended clocks.

Some tick backward.

One repeatedly strikes thirteen.

Shizuki wrote:

'TIME HERE IS FAKE.

I WILL BE LATE TO NOTHING.'
introTwitch:
A school of Jellyfish drifts through suspended clocks.

Some tick backward.

One repeatedly strikes thirteen.

Shizuki wrote:

'TIME HERE IS FAKE.

I WILL BE LATE TO NOTHING.'

clocktide-drift-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Clocktide Drift.

left.message:
Star Candies orbit a clock frozen at a time that has no corresponding
hour.

right.message:
A Clocktide Jelly pulses once.

The clock beside it loses four minutes.

You feel cheated.

forward.message:
A still second stretches long enough to rest inside it.

Shizuki's note:

'Took five-minute nap.

Apparently was six hours.

Best nap ever.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

clocktide-drift-depths.prompt: Deeper within Clocktide Drift, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Jelly drifts backward through its own previous position.

right.message:
A cache contains a note dated tomorrow.

The handwriting is yours.

No thank you.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's clock:

'Set alarm.

Alarm went off yesterday.

Clock confiscated.'

clocktide-drift-threshold.prompt: Near Still Second Chamber, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
A single second refuses to end.

Plenty of time to recover.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Clocktide Jelly swims through that same second with you.

forward.message: A coffer arrives from the future looking slightly annoyed.

bossPromptDiscord:
Still Second Chamber freezes.

Bubbles stop rising.

Light stops moving.

Only one enormous bell-shaped silhouette continues drifting.

Use /yes to enter or /no to remain safely attached to
chronological order.
bossPromptTwitch:

Bubbles stop rising.

Light stops moving.

Only one enormous bell-shaped silhouette continues drifting.

Use !yes to enter or !no to remain safely attached to
chronological order.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Still Second Chamber. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Time resumes around one creature that never stopped.

Hourless Medusa reveals itself!

completionText:
The clocks restart.

One reads:

NOW.

Finally, useful.
